integrity: Proof given for all \(m\ge3\). The finite Jacobian checker corroborates cases m=3..6 without replacing the general proof. Source Hilbert-series multiplicity at the origin is acknowledged as prior work; historical priority beyond checked sources has residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact completed-local-ring and conductor claims concern nonzero complex points. The singular locus is described with reduced structure; the Jacobian singular scheme, the global conductor at the origin, and a local equation at the origin are not determined.
title: Local branch and multiplicity stratification of the zero-diagonal minimal-nilpotent fiber
